mapper.sql: select em.evaluation_material_id as "evaluationMaterialId", em.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", em.area_code as "areaCode", em.organization_code as "organizationCode", em.target_user_id as "targetUserId", em.source_achievement_id as "sourceAchievementId", em.generation_batch_id as "generationBatchId", em.material_status as "finalStatus", case when em.material_status != 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED' then true else false end as "canDelete", case when em.material_status = 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED' then '평가확정 자료는 확정취소 후 삭제할 수 있습니다.' else null end as "excludedReason", em.created_at as "createdAt" from evaluation_materials em
mapper.select: order by em.created_at desc, em.evaluation_material_id desc limit #{criteria.safeSize} offset #{criteria.offset}

select count(*) from evaluation_materials em
and em.material_status != 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED'
mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_batch_jobs (batch_job_id, batch_type, evaluation_year, area_code, organization_code, target_user_id, target_condition_json, total_count, success_count, failure_count, excluded_count, job_status, requested_by, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{batchJobId}, 'DELETION', #{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.areaCode}, null, null, jsonb_build_object('evaluationYear', #{request.evaluationYear}, 'areaCode', #{request.areaCode}, 'generationBatchId', #{request.generationBatchId}, 'previewToken', #{request.previewToken}, 'deletionReason', #{request.deletionReason}), #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failureCount}, #{excludedCount}, 'COMPLETED', #{requestedBy}, #{requestId}, #{requestedBy}, #{requestedBy})

insert into evaluation_batch_job_items (batch_job_id, target_ref, result_status, error_code, error_message, excluded_reason, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{batchJobId}, #{targetRef}, #{resultStatus}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{excludedReason}, #{requestId}, #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: update evaluation_batch_jobs set success_count = #{successCount}, failure_count = #{failureCount}, excluded_count = #{excludedCount}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() where batch_job_id = #{batchJobId}

update evaluation_materials set deleted_yn = 'Y', material_status = 'DELETED', deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, deleted_at = now(), delete_reason = #{deleteReason}, request_id = #{requestId}, updated_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = now() where evaluation_material_id = #{evaluationMaterialId} and deleted_yn = 'N' and material_status != 'EVALUATION_CONFIRMED'
